## 🛠️ Type of Change

- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation (`docs/` or `README.md`).
- [ ] For Soroban contract edits: `cargo clippy --all-targets` passes without warnings.
- [ ] For Frontend edits: `npm run build` compiles cleanly without errors.
